entities.name: Aminomethyltransferase (O86567)
observations: Exact 372-aa sequence match to reviewed Streptomyces coelicolor UniProt O86567; annotated EC 2.1.2.10, aminomethyltransferase in the glycine cleavage system.

entities.name: Glycine cleavage aminomethyl transfer
observations: Transfers the aminomethyl group from lipoyl-protein-bound aminomethyl intermediate to tetrahydrofolate, yielding reduced lipoyl-protein, 5,10-methylene-THF, and ammonium; Rhea RHEA:16945.

entities.name: Conditional reductive amination
observations: If reductive amination conditions are intended, the heteroaryl aldehyde and free piperazine nitrogen form a heteroaryl-CH2-piperazine linkage; the search found no empirical conditions confirmation.
